name: CCUS for Sustainable Industrial and Energy Systems
description: Carbon cycle, global inventories, and international policies. Fundamentals of carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) and CO₂ mitigation strategies. Power generation, thermodynamic cycles, and carbon capture technologies. Pre-combustion, post-combustion, oxyfuel, and chemical looping systems. Process simulation and techno-economic analysis. Industrial CO₂ capture: cement, steel, and sector-specific strategies. Absorption, adsorption, and membrane-based CO₂ capture methods. CO₂ conversion to fuels, chemicals, and mineral carbonation. Life cycle assessment and case studies on decarbonization. Emerging solutions for decarbonization across industries.
